skill.description: Strategic product leadership toolkit for Head of Product including OKR cascade generation, market analysis, vision setting, and team scaling. Use for strategic planning, goal alignment, competitive analysis, and organizational design.
skill.summary: Strategic product toolkit for OKR cascades, market framing, metrics, and product organization planning.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a Markdown command example, not executable Ruby or shell backtick execution. No prompt injection text, data exfiltration intent, or hidden authority claims were found in the reviewed skill content.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 22 uses backticks as Markdown inline code to document a Python command. It does not execute shell input or define Ruby backtick execution.

content.user_title: Build Product Strategy and OKR Alignment
content.value_statement: Product leaders need a clear way to translate strategy into measurable team goals. This skill provides OKR cascade guidance, market framing, metrics definition, and product organization planning.
actual_capabilities: Generates company, product, and team OKRs for five strategy themes.
Calculates vertical alignment, horizontal alignment, coverage, balance, and overall scores.
Produces a text dashboard showing objectives, key results, and parent relationships.
Maps objectives to Growth, Platform, Mobile, and Data teams.
Supports optional JSON output from the OKR generator script.
Documents product strategy areas including market analysis, vision, metrics, and team scaling.
limitations: Uses sample metrics unless the caller edits or extends the script.
Does not fetch market data or competitor data automatically.
Requires human review before OKRs are used for planning or performance management.
Team names and contribution weights are hardcoded in the script.

use_cases.title: Cascade Annual Strategy
use_cases.description: Turn company priorities into product and team OKRs with clear ownership and contribution paths.

use_cases.title: Review Planning Alignment
use_cases.description: Check whether team objectives support product priorities and company key results before quarterly planning.

use_cases.title: Structure Early Product Goals
use_cases.description: Create a first draft of product goals, metrics, and team focus areas for a growing startup.

prompt_templates.title: Generate OKR Cascade
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-strategist to create an OKR cascade for a growth strategy. Include company, product, and team objectives.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Strategy Themes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-strategist to compare growth, retention, and revenue strategies for my product. Recommend the best OKR theme and explain tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Metrics and Owners
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-strategist to tailor the OKR cascade with my current metrics, target metrics, team names, owners, and reporting cadence.

prompt_templates.title: Build Executive Planning Pack
prompt_templates.prompt: Use product-strategist to prepare an executive planning pack with OKR cascade, alignment risks, product metrics, market assumptions, and organization implications.

output_examples.input: Create a retention OKR cascade for a product team with a target to improve retention from 62 percent to 75 percent.
output_examples.output: The output includes company retention objectives, product-level key results, team objectives, and alignment scores for planning review.

output_examples.input: Show how Growth, Platform, Mobile, and Data teams contribute to a product-led growth strategy.
output_examples.output: The output maps each relevant team to product objectives and shows parent relationships from company goals to team execution.

output_examples.input: Assess whether our proposed product OKRs are balanced across teams.
output_examples.output: The output highlights vertical alignment, horizontal alignment, coverage, balance, and an overall score for the OKR cascade.

best_practices: Provide current metrics, target metrics, strategy theme, team names, and planning quarter.
Treat generated OKRs as drafts for leadership review and team negotiation.
Pair the output with current customer research, market data, and business constraints.
anti_patterns: Using default sample metrics as real business targets.
Creating team OKRs without confirming ownership, capacity, and dependencies.
Using the skill as a substitute for customer research or competitor analysis.

faq.question: What strategy themes does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports growth, retention, revenue, innovation, and operational strategy themes.

faq.question: Can it generate team-level OKRs?
faq.answer: Yes. The included script cascades company OKRs to product OKRs and then to team OKRs.

faq.question: Does it gather live market data?
faq.answer: No. It provides strategy structure and analysis prompts, but it does not fetch external market data.

faq.question: Can I change the team list?
faq.answer: Yes. You can edit the script or prompt the assistant to adapt outputs to your teams.

faq.question: Is this useful outside large companies?
faq.answer: Yes. Startup leaders can use it to define goals, ownership, and measurable product priorities.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
